old_scene_ready_judgment.evidence: SceneReadyEvidence consumes only target identity status, centroid, bbox and mask area. Butter is physically static but times out when SAM evidence disappears; the article-bearing soup phrase has no candidates on the same frames where the reference phrase stabilizes. The gate has no target-independent scene-motion input.

development_only_scene_motion_calibratio.metric: mean absolute RGB difference over all canonical pixels and channels, divided by 255
development_only_scene_motion_calibratio.stable_tail_definition_for_audit_only: tail ticks 11-80, after the recorded oracle object translation has ceased in these development captures
development_only_scene_motion_calibratio.decision_window: 3 consecutive frame pairs at or below the threshold
development_only_scene_motion_calibratio.basis: 0.00005 rounds above the largest development stable-tail p95 (0.0000351) and remains far below the normalized RGB differences during measured 21-41 mm settling steps. Freeze before held-out evaluation; do not retune on held-out episodes.

query_normalization_decision.rule: collapse whitespace, casefold for the SAM query, then remove at most one leading English determiner from {the, a, an}; preserve the raw semantic phrase in TaskSpec and logs
query_normalization_decision.evidence_basis: Same-frame phrase comparison shows 0/81 candidate frames for 'the alphabet soup' versus 81/81 for 'alphabet soup'.
query_normalization_decision.semantic_warning: The reference phrase's highest-ranked mask is visibly the neighboring Milk carton, so query normalization improves surface-form parity but does not validate the selected object's semantic identity.
